# Third-party notices

These notices cover the unmodified `index_bg.wasm` from [`@resvg/resvg-wasm` 2.6.2](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@resvg/resvg-wasm/v/2.6.2), built from [resvg-js v2.6.2](https://github.com/yisibl/resvg-js/tree/v2.6.2). Components were identified from paths embedded in the binary and by resolving normal dependencies for `wasm32-unknown-unknown` from the upstream manifest. The two sections distinguish binary-identified versions from versions resolved on 2026-11-14. Upstream has no lockfile for the binary, so the versions actually used for dependencies without embedded paths cannot be verified; resolution does not prove inclusion in the final binary. Dependencies not selected by wasm-target resolution are not added on that basis; binary-identified components are retained. License and notice texts are drawn from the identified distributions; identical texts are shared by reference.
